<function name="FocusedHasParent" parent="vgui" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns whether the currently focused panel is a child of the given one.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="parent" type="Panel">The parent panel to check the currently focused one against. This doesn't need to be a direct parent (focused panel can be a child of a child and so on).</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether or not the focused panel is a child of the passed one.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
